headline: Collect the listed clips into a folder
highlights: Collect Filtered into a Folder… gathers exactly the clips the current filter and search show, into a folder you pick
Copy (default) leaves the originals alone; Move relocates them and repoints the session so nothing breaks
Keep the original folders, or go flat with clashing names separated by the folder they came from — TAKE01#line_001.wav
Every clash is listed with what each clip becomes before anything is written; files already in the destination are never overwritten
